title: Multi Hook Wall Mount Rack 6-Hook Solid Brass 15.5-Inch | Brass Multi Hooks | Allied Brass
description:
Stop piling towels, robes, and belts on the counter—this wall-mount multi hook creates an organized, easy-to-grab storage zone in your bathroom.

Highlights:
- Keep daily essentials separated and accessible with 6-position hanging storage on one wall-mounted rack
- Maintain a clean, finished look with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Bring a balanced, transitional touch to your space with the distinctive Brass Multi Hooks collection design
- Count on enduring construction crafted from solid brass materials
- Coordinate with your bathroom hardware thanks to multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: 6-position multi hook wall rack
- Material: Solid brass
- Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw mounting hardware included
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 15.5 x 3.2 x 4 inches
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 12 x 6 x 4 inches
- Shipping weight: 3 lbs
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
